rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, a consumer AI agent with brain-inspired memory systems and a focus on private, local-first products—a space where brand entertainment and product placement (Konstantin's domain) could become a novel distribution or integration opportunity. Steven's technical depth in TypeScript, Rust, and AI systems complements Konstantin's brand-entertainment background, creating potential for exploring how AI agents might serve as platforms for immersive brand experiences.
intro_message: Konstantin, meet Steven Enamakel — a technical AI founder building personal agents with brain-inspired memory systems; his work on private, local AI could intersect with new models for brand entertainment and product integration.
